nodes.label: FlameColor.glsl (flame palette recolouring)
nodes.rationale: Shared by Flame.frag and Spark.frag: recolours an authored realistic-orange palette onto a per-instance target colour by hue-rotating each fixed stop, kept in one file so body and sparks cannot drift apart.

nodes.label: Hue-rotating recolour with identity at the default
nodes.rationale: Each authored stop is hue-rotated and its saturation pulled toward the target's, gated by circular hue distance so a flame left at the default orange comes back out unchanged bit for bit; the saturation pull is what stops a coloured flame fading to bland white at its hottest point.
